### Did Jesus Have a Favorite Bible?
Author: Dr. John Barnett
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/did-jesus-have-a-favorite-bible-bible-study-minute-february-15-2018.html
Passage: Matthew 5:17-19
Points:
- Jesus expressed absolute confidence in Scripture, affirming that not the smallest letter would pass away until everything was accomplished.
- Christ’s teaching establishes that believers can rely completely on the reliability and authority of God's Word.
- Jesus and the apostles frequently read and quoted from the Septuagint, the Greek translation of their era.
- Modern readers can trust their translated Bibles just as Jesus trusted the Scriptures in His day.

### Devotional: Matthew 5
Author: D.A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/deut-30-psalm-11973-96-isaiah-57-matthew-5/
Passage: Matthew 5:17-20
Points:
- Jesus' fulfillment of the Law does not simply mean preserving or enforcing legal demands and external rituals.
- The biblical concept of fulfillment in Matthew centers on bringing God's prophetic promises into reality.
- The entire Old Testament revelation possesses a predictive role pointing toward Jesus.
- Christ neither discards the Law nor merely maintains tradition; rather, He brings its prophetic expectations to pass.
